Merge and standardize sheets read by load_excel_parts()

Source: R/0_import_load_data.R
merge_and_standardize.Rd

Merges the separate sheets returned by load_excel_parts() into one dataset, standardizes its columns and returns it as a cd_data tibble. This is the second half of loading an Excel workbook.

Usage

merge_and_standardize(
  parts_result,
  indicator_group = c("auto", "vaccine", "rmncah", "custom"),
  profile = NULL,
  profile_name = NULL,
  validate = TRUE
)

Arguments

parts_result

A list. What load_excel_parts() returns.

indicator_group

One of "auto", "vaccine", "rmncah", "custom". Default "auto".

profile

Optional. Either a name (string) of an existing group, or a definition to register inline before loading:

  • explicit form: list(name = "rmncah", value = list(hiv = c("hiv_test","pmtct1")))

  • compact form: list(hiv_profile = list(testing = c("hiv_test"), care = c("art_new")))

For "custom", the profile must resolve to one concrete name.

profile_name

Optional. The resolved profile (indicator group) name, used when resolving the indicator group (for example with indicator_group = "custom"). Default is NULL.

validate

Logical. Whether to stop with an error when the merged data fails a data quality check: check_district_consistency(), check_month_presence() or check_month_validity(). Default is TRUE. With FALSE a file that has such problems still loads, so the caller can run the checks later with run_all_quality_checks(). Structural checks, such as a missing Admin sheet column, always run.

Value

A tibble of class cd_data.

Details

Before merging, the function stops with an error if the Admin sheet fails check_admin_columns() or check_single_country(). The merged data then goes to new_countdown(), which resolves the indicator group and, when validate is TRUE, stops on a data quality problem.

Examples

path <- system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core")
sheets <- load_excel_parts(path)
#> ℹ Loading Excel "kenya.xlsx" for parts
data <- merge_and_standardize(sheets)
#> ! The following columns are empty: anc_1trimester, under5_deaths, total_deaths,
#>   ipv2, measles_cases
#> ℹ Successfully loaded and cleaned data
#> ℹ Auto-detect candidates (|group|): vaccine=19, rmncah=28 -> selected rmncah
